input_file.description: Path to the source code file to be formatted. Use /dev/stdin for standard input.

output_file.description: Path to the output LaTeX file. Use /dev/stdout for standard output.

line_length.description: Maximum line length for the generated LaTeX output.

tab_width.description: Number of spaces to substitute for a tab character in the output.

line_number_interval.description: Interval for adding line number prefixes. 0 disables line numbers, 1 adds every line.

use_tiny_numbers.description: If true, uses \tiny for line numbers; if false, uses \footnotesize.

language.description: Input source language for syntax highlighting (e.g., c, java, python, sql).
